skill.summary: Test web applications for client-side security vulnerabilities spanning two major attack families: client-side trust anti-patterns and user-targeting attacks...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of client-side attack testing skill.

- Provides a structured process for identifying and exploiting client-side control bypasses and user-targeting vulnerabilities in web applications.
- Supports security testing for CSRF, clickjacking, open redirection, HTTP header injection, session fixation, cookie injection, and privacy exposures (not XSS).
- Maps findings to OWASP Testing Guide and major CWE categories, with guidance on severity and remediation.
- Designed for penetration testers, appsec engineers, and security-focused developers using HTTP intercepting proxies like Burp Suite.
- Includes detailed guidance on when and how to use the skill, plus requirements and triggers for use.
